page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c1.large is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the ecs.c1 family. It is configured with 8 dedicated physical cores and 8 vCPUs, operating with a 1.0 thread-per-core ratio. The instance features 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 2.0 GB per core.

This server type utilizes the KVM hypervisor for virtualization. It does not include any bundled local storage, meaning storage must be attached externally. There are no integrated GPUs, and it does not come with complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

With a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the instance is structured for compute-heavy tasks rather than memory-intensive applications. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance without resource contention. It is suitable for workloads such as web serving, batch processing, and lightweight computational tasks that require dedicated CPU resources but have modest memory footprints.
